# Compute per-person cable bill share from receipt
from decimal import Decimal

receipt_content = "\nCable Bill from InfinityCable for duration => 2023-04-01 - 2023-04-30\n\nJennifer Powell\n34495 Michael Burg Suite 805\nSeattle\nWashington\nUnited States\n38887\nAccount Number => 227844069\nBase Charges => $108\nService Fee => $10.00\nTaxes and Fees => $10.0\nTotal Amount => $128\n"

# Extract the total amount number after 'Total Amount => $'
import re
m = re.search(r"Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)", receipt_content)
print('matched_total', m.group(1) if m else None)
total = Decimal(m.group(1))

# Roommates list from phone contacts
roommates = [
    {'contact_id': 571, 'name': 'Connor Brown', 'email': 'connorbrow@gmail.com', 'phone': '5734599766'},
    {'contact_id': 573, 'name': 'Edwin Wilson', 'email': 'ed_wilson@gmail.com', 'phone': '8506051563'},
    {'contact_id': 572, 'name': 'Martin Blackburn', 'email': 'mar_blac@gmail.com', 'phone': '3539110281'},
]
people_including_me = len(roommates) + 1
share = total / Decimal(people_including_me)
print('total', total)
print('people_including_me', people_including_me)
print('share_per_person', share)

from decimal import Decimal

# Re-login to Venmo using stored supervisor credentials
pw_map = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
venmo_pass = [x['password'] for x in pw_map if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_auth = apis.venmo.login(username='jepowell@gmail.com', password=venmo_pass)
access_token = venmo_auth['access_token']

# Roommates (from phone contacts relationship='roommate')
roommates = [
    {'contact_id': 571, 'name': 'Connor Brown', 'email': 'connorbrow@gmail.com'},
    {'contact_id': 573, 'name': 'Edwin Wilson', 'email': 'ed_wilson@gmail.com'},
    {'contact_id': 572, 'name': 'Martin Blackburn', 'email': 'mar_blac@gmail.com'},
]

# Share amount derived from receipt Total Amount => $128 and 4 people total (me + 3 roommates)
share = Decimal('32')

results = []
for r in roommates:
    resp = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        user_email=r['email'],
        amount=float(share),
        access_token=access_token,
        description='I paid for cable bill.'
    )
    print('created_request_for', r['name'], r['email'], 'resp', resp)
    results.append((r['email'], resp))

print('total_created', len(results))
